ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Qué haces con el paraguas,

{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Du trägst an einem so schönen Tag
einen Schirm, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bist du
etwa aus Zucker, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Böyle muhteşem bir günde niye şemsiye

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu ne sors pas ton parapluie par ce

{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Şemsiye kapalı mı? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hem de yağmurlu

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sigues bajo la lluvia, ¿eh?
¿Esperas que te salgan
aletas, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E quindi, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}hai deciso di rimanere
fuori nonostante la pioggia,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sì, non ne ho mai abbastanza,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Pioggia! {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Pioggia!{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
Pioggiaaa!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:000A:}}Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Oh! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Scusami, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Mi sono

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La lluvia es viiida, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Ven y tócame{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el lomo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}que lo
tengo viscosillo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}perdona, se me olvidaba que
eso no está bien visto si no eres
una rana.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} No he dicho nada.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Quoi de plus merveilleux que la
pluie, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Touche ma peau,
comme elle est lisse et glaireuse !
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000A:}}Comment ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} « BEURK » ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je vois,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
on fait pas partie du même monde,
décidément, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oh, wie ich den Regen liebe!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hier,
fühl mal meine Haut, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Total schleimig, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}das könnte natürlich auch eklig
sein für... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}äh... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Nichtfrösche.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Vergiss, was ich gesagt habe.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bu yağmura bayılmamak elde değil,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Gel—tenime dokun! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Şu an
acayip kaygan, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0003:000F:}}Şey,
{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}ama kurbağa değilsen bu biraz iğrenç
gelebilir, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}yani, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}hımm. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ne dediysem

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Still making your way through all
this rainy stuff, huh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aún aguantas bajo la lluvia,
¿eh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} ¡Eso son ganas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu espères toujours passer entre
les gouttes, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Hé hé,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Come te la passi con tutta questa
pioggia, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hast du immer noch nicht genug
von diesem scheußlichen Wetter,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bunca yağmurun içinde hâlâ yoluna devam
ediyorsun ha, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}I see that you like
staying out in the rain too! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I love the
way it makes my head all swimmy.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oye, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}me he fijado en
que a ti también te gusta la lluvia.
¡Tú sí que sabes!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hé, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Toi aussi, tu aimes
rester sous la pluie pour rendre ta
peau plus luisante ? {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ehi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}vedo che anche a
te piace star fuori quando piove.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}L'importante è avere il gel giusto,
così niente può fermarci!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du bist wohl auch
gern draußen im Regen. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich bin
schon richtig benebelt davon.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}sen de yağmurda kalmayı
seviyorsun görüyorum! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Kafamı böyle hafif
döndürmesine bayılıyorum.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Regarde un peu tes cheveux,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu n'as donc aucun
amour propre ?
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Et non : {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}la pluie n'est PAS une
excuse.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ancora fuori sotto la pioggia,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Secondo me ti piace
farti la doccia gratis, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Immer noch draußen im Regen,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du bist bestimmt
schon klitschnass, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yağmurun altında kalmaya devam
mı, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sırılsıklam olmayı seviyorsun
herhâlde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
I've seen a few umbrellas around
today, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}but I just don't
get those things.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Rainy days are the best days of
the year for maintaining a
slimy complexion, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

con paraguas hoy, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Y no lo entiendo!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}La lluvia es el mejor tratamiento

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dis, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}c'est quoi cette manie qu'ont
les gens de sortir leur parapluie
dès qu'il pleut,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?

pourtant simple à comprendre !

Ehi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Ho visto in giro
un po' di ombrelli oggi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}ma proprio
non capisco...

Heute hab ich jede Menge Schirme
gesehen, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Was wollen
denn alle mit diesen Dingern?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Regentage sind die beste
